title: Privacy Policy for PoE2 Build Lab
description: Privacy policy for PoE2 Build Lab, including analytics and the site's currently disabled advertising status.
heading: Privacy Policy
content:
Effective date: 2026-07-19

PoE2 Build Lab is a static informational website. The site does not collect account registrations, comments, payments, or direct personal information.

Analytics

The site may use Google Search Console to understand how pages appear in Google Search. Search Console reports aggregated search performance and does not create user accounts on this site.

Advertising

Advertising is currently disabled. No AdSense, DoubleClick, or other advertising script is loaded by any page. The publisher declaration may remain in ads.txt, but it does not itself load code or set cookies. Advertising will remain disabled until a Google-certified consent management platform is configured and this policy is updated.

External links

The site links to external resources such as official game pages, patch notes, and GitHub. External sites have their own privacy policies.

Contact

For privacy questions or corrections, contact the maintainer through the GitHub repository.
